summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with its half-year operating and financial review and unaudited consolidated financial statements for the six months ended April 30, 2026. The filing describes the company's business of developing private-label skincare, product sales, and franchise operations, with 21 franchisees in China as of the reporting date. There are no event-driven special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The 6-K is a routine periodic report filed by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16.
